title: Add typed per-task details to the task_sync_import_conflict refusal for TermAl consumption
outcome: Add typed per-task details to the task_sync_import_conflict refusal for TermAl consumption
acceptance: A task_sync_import_conflict refusal carries a typed details.tasks array, one entry per refused task with its work id, a stable reason code and a detail, in task-id order, while the human message stays unchanged
The typed details are transient error data only: no durable row, schema or host-protocol change
